svg.aria-label: Prior art mapped onto the Stereo Ultrasound design pipeline. Centre column: our eight process stages, from the owner gate through the lead AI, parallel design teams, adversarial verification, serial integration, the docs/system blackboard and plm.py tracker, code-defined hardware with simulation checks, to rev-1 physical test. Left: eight pre-LLM research clusters (1968-2022). Right: eight LLM-era clusters (2023-2026). Each cluster points at the stage it informs and names the lessons it supports. Green border: a proven method to copy; orange: partial or weak evidence; red: failure evidence to guard against. Three stages carry a FRONTIER tag: doing them across electronics, mechanics and firmware with agent teams under one human owner has no precedent in about 100 opened works.
svg.text: Prior art mapped onto our design pipeline
Left: pre-LLM engineering research (1968-2022). Right: the LLM era (2023-2026). Centre: our process. L# = ranked lesson in docs/research/prior-art-agentic-engineering.md (2026-10-01).
lead merges one team at a time;
docs/system + plm.py: watches on nets, parts,
Ward et al. 1995; Sobek, Ward & Liker 1999;
Keep feasible sets open, intersect them, narrow late.
Evidence: single-firm case studies; complex to run.
A shared record plus a monitor works, but the model has
no control rule: write down who acts next.
Klein et al. 2003; Sosa et al. 2004; Conway 1968;
Tight coupling split across teams converges slowly.
Cut teams along coupling clusters; re-form each cycle.
versions of one program, 1 million tests
Independent authors fail together on the hard parts.
Doorstop: suspect links cleared one link at a time
An interface is re-baselined only when every side
that must approve it has signed.
reviews: Whitfield et al. 2000, Shen et al. 2008
Our architecture, 30 years early. It faded. Our reading:
weak agents, ontology and wrapper cost; PLM won.
Rank impact by likelihood x impact; margins absorb change.
No paper in the review reports ongoing industrial use.
Generated designs that were built and tested
Worked inside a space the simulator models well; the
engineer fixed the form, the search set the numbers.
Co-planning plus rare, well-placed approvals beat full
autonomy; low-risk approval requests annoy users.
Parallel: +81% on decomposable tasks, -39% to -70% on
small gains. LLM agents: 0% complete on large boards.
No self-correction without outside feedback; models
agree when wrong; a judge between two sides works.
2023 GPT-4 planning and risk studies; AGENTS.md
Nothing found on agents running change control. Context
files: no gain, +20% cost. Stale memory spotted ~55%.
Mature, not new. Typed limits and assertions at build
time; real-board STEP inside the shell for clashes.
88% of runs executed, 2 of 15 answers valid; 'new'
materials were not new: the auto-checker was unreliable.
no precedent found for this stage across electronics + mechanics + firmware
with agent teams under one human owner (about 100 works opened, 2026-10-01; web search was exhausted, so commercial tools are unseen).
